properties.name: panama_transit_core
properties.description: Nested sensitivity AOI for the Panama drought study: the Pacific-side active transit corridor - Miraflores and Pedro Miguel locks, the Gaillard (Culebra) Cut and its northern approach - deliberately excluding Gatun Lake and the Pacific gulf anchorages where restricted vessels wait.
properties.navigation_rationale: Northbound convoys wait in the Pacific anchorages (west of -79.60, south of 8.95) and southbound convoys wait in Gatun Lake (north of 9.15). Both waiting areas are outside this box, so a restriction-driven increase in dwell should not appear here, while the physical transit corridor itself is captured. Chosen from the navigation chart before inspecting any Phase 4B effect.
properties.caveat: The corridor is a thin water strip inside a mostly land box, so water-normalized coverage is mandatory.
